OCM is an Oil cleansing Method, Its where you take an oil that does not clog pores (cause acne) such as Mineral Oil or Sunflower Oil, and message your face with it. Then clean the oil off your face using wet warm microfibre cloths to remove the oil and rince the cloth in warm water and repeat until the oil is gone. OCM is recommended for all skin types, Oil to dry, this is because all skin types can be dehydrated.

BHA is a chemical exfoliant. Its a chemical you apply to your face to get rid of dead skin cells. Its helpful because its a lot more gentle then scrubs and recommended for acne prone people.

Since you said your oil was for hormones, then chances are it effected your hormones and it will take your skin some time to adjust to getting use to it. Try to see a doctor and tell them about the hormones and acne situation, they should be able to help.
